Yes, flipping "Add to Read later" on during the save review feels right — it's a simple way to flag something I mean to get back to. And I like that it's just an on/off marker that doesn't pull the link out of my main collection; the article still lives with everything else, it's just also marked for reading. That model fits.

Two things tied to this that I'd want, since read-later is only useful if I can act on it: I'd expect a way to see just my read-later items in one place, so I can sit down and go through them — and then, once I've read something, to mark it as done so it drops off that reading list (but stays saved in my collection). As long as I can do those, this is what I want.
